shortDescription: Manage the list of users for an Fabric operations console

options.name: api_authtype
options.description: C(basic) - Authenticate to the Fabric operations console using basic authentication. You must provide both a valid API key using I(api_key) and API secret using I(api_secret).

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The URL for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_key
options.description: The API key for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: The API secret for the Fabric operations console. Only required when I(api_authtype) is C(basic).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: The timeout, in seconds, to use when interacting with the Fabric operations console.

options.name: email
options.description: The email address of the user.

options.name: roles
options.description: The roles for the user. A user must have one or more roles from the list of roles C(reader), C(writer), and C(manager). If you specify C(manager), then the roles C(reader) and C(writer) will be automatically specified for you. If you specify C(writer), then the role C(reader) will be automatically specified for you.

options.name: state
options.description: C(absent) - A user matching the specified email will be removed from the IBM Blockchain Platform console. C(present) - Asserts that a user matching the specified email and configuration exists in the Fabric operations console. If no user matches the specified email, the user will be added to the Fabric operations console. If a user matches the specified email but the configuration does not match, then the user in the Fabric operations console will be updated.
